title: Absent-role demand inertness (the fold-only spine for juice.t1 and the other 31 re-blessed .t1 files) has no lowest-layer unit pin
location: core/flow.odin:749 (untested gate) vs core/demand_test.odin:326-345 (era-0 analogue only)
detail: The PR's claim that pre-5.11 demos (juice included) shift only via the catalog fold rests on flow.odin's len>0 gate drawing no rng. Era-0 and growth-disabled inertness have direct pins (test_era0_legacy_no_rng_draws, test_growth_disabled_is_inert); the era-3 absent-role case is pinned only indirectly by the 33-demo golden gate, violating the project's pin-invariants-at-lowest-layer rule.
recommended_fix: Add a core @(test): era 3, catalog containing the small_biz/campus entries, topology with no such nodes; snapshot state.rng, step N ticks, assert rng unchanged and no spawns of those classes (mirror test_era0_legacy_no_rng_draws).
